title: Valentine’s Sugar Cookies 💕 Soft, fluffy, and baked with love ✨ Makes...
description: Valentine’s Sugar Cookies 💕 Soft, fluffy, and baked with love ✨ Makes 8-10 cookies! Recipe:  Cookies 	•	2 cups + 2 Tbsp all-purpose flour (255g) 	•	¼ tsp baking powder 	•	½ tsp baking soda 	•	¼ tsp salt 	•	10 Tbsp unsalted butter, softened (141g) 	•	½ cup granulated sugar (100g) 	•	⅓ cup light brown sugar, packed (71g) 	•	1 egg, room temperature 	•	1 Tbsp vanilla extract 🤍 	•	¾ cup Valentine sprinkles (120g) + more for topping Cream Cheese Frosting 	•	6 oz cream cheese, softened (170g) 	•	5 Tbsp unsalted butter, softened (70g) 	•	1 Tbsp vanilla extract ✨ 	•	Pinch of salt 	•	2 cups powdered sugar (227g) ⸻ Instructions For the cookies 	1.	Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 	2.	In a large bowl, beat the butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until light and fluffy. 	3.	Add the egg and 1 Tbsp vanilla. Mix until combined. 	4.	Add the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt directly into the bowl. 	5.	Mix until just combined. 	6.	Gently fold in the Valentine sprinkles. 	7.	Scoop dough using a 3 Tbsp cookie scoop, place on the baking sheet, and lightly press down. 	8.	Bake for 9–11 minutes until set but still soft. Let cookies cool completely before frosting. For the frosting 	1.	Beat cream cheese, butter, 1 Tbsp vanilla, and salt until smooth and creamy. 	2.	Add powdered sugar and mix until fluffy. 	3.	Pipe frosting onto cooled cookies and finish with extra sprinkles 💌 #Valentinesdaycookies #baking #Valentinesdaybaking #cookies #sugarcookies
